seo.title: Privacy Policy - TuGet Desktop Client
seo.description: Privacy Policy for TuGet Desktop Client, detailing local media storage guarantees and minimal network data interaction boundaries.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.introPrefix: This Privacy Policy applies to the TuGet official website and TuGet Desktop software operated by
privacyPage.introSuffix: ('we' or 'us'). We are committed to protecting your privacy under the principles of data minimization and transparency.
privacyPage.s1Intro: When you use the desktop client, purchase a license, or activate the software, we process only the minimum necessary information:
privacyPage.s1Item1Text: The email address used to receive your activation code, selected plan type, order amount, merchant order number, and payment status. Payment processing is handled directly by official Alipay or Stripe checkouts—we never access your payment passwords or full card numbers.
privacyPage.s1Item2Text: Your TGTU activation code, irreversible device hardware hash (used solely to enforce your plan's concurrent device limit), OS version, and license expiration status.
privacyPage.s1Item3Text: Upon launch, the client sends a lightweight heartbeat ping to our official telemetry endpoint containing an irreversible device hash, client version, and OS type (plus license status if activated) to measure version stability. We never collect the URLs you visit or the media files you capture.
privacyPage.s2BoxText: All webpage URLs you submit, as well as the images, videos, audio files, and task lists you capture in TuGet Desktop, are stored exclusively on your local computer drive. We never upload your captured assets to any cloud server.
privacyPage.s3Body: Order and licensing data is used strictly to deliver activation codes, manage concurrent device bindings, issue invoices, provide technical support, and comply with statutory accounting requirements. All network communications are encrypted via HTTPS/TLS.
privacyPage.s4Intro: To operate core services, we integrate with compliant infrastructure providers:
privacyPage.s4Item1Text: Used to process order payments securely;
privacyPage.s4Item2Text: Used to deliver activation codes and order receipts;
privacyPage.s4Item3Text: Used on our website to measure aggregate page views and Microsoft Store download clicks without collecting personally identifiable information;
privacyPage.s4Item4Text: Communicates with the desktop client over HTTPS for license verification, device limit enforcement, and version heartbeat checks.
privacyPage.s5Body: The number of active devices is governed by your purchased plan. If you need to transfer your license to a new computer, or wish to query or update order records associated with your email, please contact our support team at any time.
privacyPage.s6Before: For any privacy-related questions or requests, please contact us at:
